description: This file implements network management event handling for Zephyr OS, including callback registration, event notification, and synchronization mechanisms.

methods.name: net_mgmt_add_event_callback
methods.description: Registers a callback for network management events and updates the global event mask.

methods.name: net_mgmt_del_event_callback
methods.description: Removes a registered callback and rebuilds the global event mask.

methods.name: net_mgmt_event_notify_with_info
methods.description: Notifies registered callbacks of an event with optional info if the event is handled.

methods.name: net_mgmt_event_wait
methods.description: Waits synchronously for a specified network management event.

methods.name: net_mgmt_event_wait_on_iface
methods.description: Waits synchronously for a specified event on a specific network interface.

methods.name: net_mgmt_event_init
methods.description: Initializes the network management event system, including setting up threads and queues if configured.
